Property mappings are created using the following rules:
Destination properties must have a public getter and must not be indexers.
Destination properties must have a public setter or be a supported getter-only collection.

member.summary: Provides a thread-safe cache for compiled instances.

Mapping plans are cached using the source and destination type pair as the cache key. This avoids repeatedly building mapping plans for the same combination of types.
The cache uses to support concurrent access and to ensure that each mapping plan is initialized only once when multiple threads request it simultaneously.
